item.title: Confirm a clinic interpreter
item.context_text: You help a neighbour understand appointment arrangements. The message offers two interpreter slots and a different check-in for video calls.
item.objective_text: Find the slot that works and communicate the check-in details.
success_conditions: Find the slot that works and communicate the check-in details.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
APPOINTMENT UPDATE
The appointment is Tuesday at 16:00. An interpreter can attend in person only before 15:00, but can join by video at 16:00. There is no extra charge. To use video, arrive 15 minutes early and ask reception for Tablet 2. Please confirm your choice by 12:00 on Monday. Your neighbour cannot finish work before 15:30.

questions.prompt: Why is video the practical choice?
options: The neighbour can stay only until 15:00
The clinic charges for in-person help
The in-person interpreter is unavailable when the neighbour can attend
questions.explanation: Work finishes at 15:30, after the in-person option ends.

questions.prompt: What must happen by Monday noon?
options: Arrive at reception for the appointment
questions.explanation: Monday noon is the confirmation deadline, not the appointment time.

children.title: Confirm with the clinic
children.prompt_text: Clinic: Which interpreter arrangement works for you?
children.instructions: Confirm the date, time and video option, then ask about the early arrival.
children.model_answer: Hello, please book a video interpreter for Tuesday at 16:00. My neighbour can arrive at 15:45, fifteen minutes early as requested. Should we ask directly at the main reception desk for Tablet 2?

children.title: Explain check-in to your neighbour
children.prompt_text: Neighbour: What do I do when I get there?
children.instructions: Say when to arrive and what to ask for.
children.model_answer: Please arrive at a quarter to four. At reception, say you're waiting for the video interpreter and ask to borrow Tablet Two for the appointment.
